title: Trail backpack
summary: 28 litres, waterproof, with a laptop sleeve.
description: A backpack for day hikes and commuting. Water resistant fabric, a padded back panel and a separate sleeve for a 15 inch laptop.

title: Insulated bottle
summary: Keeps drinks cold for a day or hot for twelve hours.
description: Double walled stainless steel, 750 ml, with a lid that does not leak when the bottle is on its side.

title: Merino socks
description: A pack of three pairs of merino wool socks. They stay warm when wet and do not hold odours.

title: Headlamp
description: Three brightness modes and a red light for reading. A full charge lasts about eight hours on the middle mode.

title: Camp stove
summary: Folds to the size of a fist.
description: A compact gas stove that boils a litre of water in under four minutes. Gas canister not included.

title: Rain shell
summary: Light, breathable, packs into its own pocket.
description: A three layer shell with taped seams. It weighs 280 grams and packs into its own chest pocket.
